scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sehemistan/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @sehemistan/api" "npm run dev -w @sehemistan/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sehemistan/contracts && npm run build -w @sehemistan/api && npm run build -w @sehemistan/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sehemistan/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sehemistan/api && npm run typecheck -w @sehemistan/web
